entries.text: Lawmakers must reject liability shields that trade away the right to sue for administrative payouts funded by industry excise taxes.
Congress should replace legacy tort paralysis with a National AI Injury Compensation Program funded by a 1.5 percent excise tax on frontier compute providers.

audience_questions.question: How do administrative payouts protect civil rights compared to traditional tort litigation?
Will federal safety standards be too rigid to accommodate the rapid pace of AI innovation?
